mock_contracts_checked: Auxiliary linker inputs with a suffix outside the generic export list are fingerprinted in all four forwarding forms.
Mutation and deletion fail receipt validation or creation.
Empty and incomplete input options fail closed.
Compiler output-related environment variables are removed in compiler mode.
Native mode environment equality is checked including all inherited output-control markers.
Forwarded linker persistence options reject before execution.
amendment_verification.source_verdict: No blocker found for the two narrow amendments; native queue behavior remains unchanged.

findings.amendment_contract: Both supported auxiliary inputs are normalized and fingerprinted for equals, comma, separate forwarded and -Xlinker forms; missing paths fail closed. Response files and general transitive linker script forms are rejected.
findings.required_change: Parse supported auxiliary linker input forms and bind their real files, or reject unbound forms; cover mutation detection.
findings.summary: The linker-option branch handles -Wl arguments before generic equals-value path extraction. Supported normalized version-script and dynamic-list equals forms do not enter the closure input fingerprints unless independently captured by another rule.

findings.amendment_contract: Only compiler_environment=True strips linker reproduction, Clang output logging/statistics controls and extra compiler caches. Forwarded linker output flags and compiler process-statistics output flags fail closed; compiler_environment=False retains the original environment.
findings.required_change: Remove the inherited linker reproduction-output variable in compiler_environment=True; preserve native runner environment behavior.
findings.summary: The compiler-specific environment retains a linker output control variable that can archive input files, bypassing command-line output filtering.

limits: No real production graph adaptation, anonymous compiler/linker transport, scope cancellation, linker wrapping or native execution was run in this review.
Cross-driver serialization also relies on root releasing the documented execution phase; the source scan is not a shared lease acquired by every separate driver.
Installed compiler/SDK and generated closure coverage still require first actual prepared-closure inspection before broad provenance claims.
The active SQL-native path does not invoke LLD and does not depend on compiler_environment=True; no active queue interruption is required by these two findings.
scope: Independent source review; no builds, compiler, linker, native execution, generated workloads or raw diagnostics persisted.
source_contracts_without_blocker: Command manifest and generated source/object/executable use memfds; worker validates reopened descriptors and explicitly inherits them.
Compiler diagnostics are hashed and discarded; native stdout is bounded and parsed into a closed numeric/boolean contract schema.
No compiler/native core dumps are allowed in the worker.
Scope membership, process-group fallback, host headroom and timeout are monitored; cancellation and normal leftover cleanup fail closed if cleanup cannot be proven.
Active direct-C++ serial lease requires released work-state phase and clean exact revision; CLI itself does not alter correctness case statuses.
Successful closure inputs and graph are rechecked after direct execution; accepted paired contracts require complete matching provenance and no regressions.
Q15 admission remains fixed-only, Q27 remains source-extracted, and direct contracts never claim full query semantics or full quality verification.
